title: Tapered Pierced Wedge And Continuous Wire Loop Nut
description: One newly authored complete fixed wired-nut-inspired decorative display lying at rest. One solid tapered wedge head contains two genuine full-length rectangular bores. One entire continuous closed pale cable loop runs through both bores, returns in a small exposed upper bend and opens into one broad lower loop. A whole short dark sleeve surrounds the two lower strands. The wedge has a broad finite flat sole and the lower cable has finite polygonal resting facets. Three complete closed components with three opaque constant untextured PBR roles, metre units and native Z up, whole horizontal bounds centred at the ground datum. All numeric head, hole, cable and sleeve geometry is new: no cam lobes, trigger mechanism, ascender shell, carabiner or prior equipment fragments imported. One independent model zero scenes. Category-level outdoor-equipment appearance only, no branding, numbers, markings or exact commercial product. Deliberately fixed cable seating overlaps the inner bore walls locally to root the visual assembly while leaving true open air strips; not real manufacturing clearance, sliding fit or cable construction. Smooth solid cable exterior rather than strands, no internal swage detail. Pure static visual prop only, never actual climbing equipment: no placement, protection, rope use, fall arrest, strength, load rating, certification, manufacture, user fit or safety capability made or verified. No rigging, animation or interaction.
